### 🐛 Describe the bug

 kimi-k3-w4a8模型基于vllm-ascend: 0.30.0rc2镜像启动，启动脚本：
```
#!/bin/bash
# 自动检测本机IP和网络接口
LOCAL_IP=$(hostname -I | awk '{print $1}')
NIC_NAME=$(route -n 2>/dev/null | grep '^0.0.0.0' | awk '{print $8}' | head -1)
# 如果route命令失败，尝试从/sys/class/net获取
if [ -z "$NIC_NAME" ]; then
    NIC_NAME=$(ls /sys/class/net/ | grep -v lo | head -1)
fi
MASTER_IP="${LWS_LEADER_ADDRESS}"

# 设置昇腾环境变量
export HCCL_IF_IP=$LOCAL_IP
export GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME=$NIC_NAME

export VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S=7200
export PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
export OMP_PROC_BIND=false
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
export TASK_QUEUE_ENABLE=1
export HCCL_BUFFSIZE=800

#MODEL_PATH=/inspire/sj-ssd3/global_public/public_models/Kimi-K3-W4A8
MODEL_PATH=/inspire/sj-ssd3/project/embodied-multimodality-ascend/public/models/Kimi-K3-W4A8
PORT=8016

TP_SIZE=16
DP_SIZE=4
DP_LOCAL_SIZE=1
DP_START_RANK=$(( ${DP_LOCAL_SIZE} * ${LWS_WORKER_INDEX}))
# EAGLE_PATH=/inspire/sj-ssd3/project/embodied-multimodality-ascend/public/models/kimi-k2.5-eagle3

# 根据节点角色选择不同的启动命令
if [ "${LWS_WORKER_INDEX}" -eq 0 ]; then
    # Master节点（节点0）
    vllm serve ${MODEL_PATH} \
        --host 0.0.0.0 \
        --port ${PORT} \
        --tensor-parallel-size ${TP_SIZE} \
        --data-parallel-size ${DP_SIZE} \
        --data-parallel-size-local  ${DP_LOCAL_SIZE}  \
        --data-parallel-start-rank  ${DP_START_RANK} \
        --data-parallel-address ${LWS_LEADER_ADDRESS} \
        --data-parallel-rpc-port 12890 \
        --served-model-name Kimi-K3-W4A8 \
	    --trust-remote-code \
        --enable-prefix-caching \
        --enable-expert-parallel \
	    --max-num-seqs 16 \
	    --max-model-len 32768 \
        --max-num-batched-tokens 4096 \

        --host 0.0.0.0 \
```
